問い: 収縮期血圧が 100 mmHg より低いか、139 mmHg より高い記録の、収縮期血圧の値
aqls:
SELECT o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude
FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v1]
WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude < 100 AND o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude > 139
